title: Caro-Kann Defence
transcript: A complete Caro-Kann repertoire for Black: 1.e4 c6 2.d4 d5, getting the light-squared bishop out before closing the centre. You meet the Advance with ...Bf5 and ...c5, the Classical with ...Bf5-g6 and a rock-solid set-up, the Exchange and Panov with active pieces against White's centre, and every common sideline with a simple plan. The positions are sound and easy to understand, and you learn how to punish the mistakes club players actually make.
